title: Rehearse the installed native drift-review form

requirement.summary: Install the exact reviewed Adapter 1.4.0 source into the existing local AgentGov environment and run one bounded Native MCP drift-review form rehearsal in an independent temporary repository.

objective.rationale: The development-source form is implemented and validated but remains uninstalled. Product review selected installed-runtime and one-replay evidence as the next P0 acceptance gate.

goal: Build and hash the exact current source offline, replace only the existing local AgentGov pipx runtime, prove Adapter 1.4.0 seven/five-tool negotiation, and run exactly one privacy-bounded temporary-repository replay without allowing the Agent or bridge to manufacture the human form decision.
non_goals: Do not change Core semantics, schemas, source behavior, or the accepted foreground architecture to make the rehearsal pass.
Do not modify the project .codex/config.toml, activate a consumer, install another host Adapter, or create a persistent replay service.
Do not let the Coding Agent, bridge, transport permission, or preflight select the record, snooze, or no-record human choice.
Do not claim form emission proves live human UI clarity, semantic review quality, or runtime enforcement beyond the mediated tool.

Do not modify this project's Git state or any remote, and do not commit, push, publish, release, deploy, merge, or perform production execution; an empty git init inside the disposable replay directory is permitted only to satisfy the repository-binding precondition.
acceptance_signals: The exact current source is built offline, hash-recorded, and installed only into the existing AgentGov pipx runtime with no dependency download or project configuration change.
Installed identity reports package 0.3.0rc1, Adapter 1.4.0, protocol 2026-07-28, seven tools with negotiated form capability, and five base tools without it.
A fresh temporary repository has a deterministic due drift-review state and an ephemeral Codex configuration that enables the exact seven-tool surface without changing this project's configuration.

Exactly one replay either reaches the native drift-review elicitation or records a bounded terminal/error outcome that localizes the unmet stage without retaining raw prompt, model output, tool arguments, or form content.

No Agent, bridge, tool permission, or fixture selects the human form choice; if a human decision cannot be obtained through the live surface, the replay stops zero-write and records that limit honestly.
Any accepted human choice is rebound to the current due-state digest, creates at most one immutable record or no record according to that exact choice, and grants no downstream authority.
The project configuration hash, consumer state, Git state, published artifacts, and release identity remain unchanged.
validation_commands: python -m unittest tests.test_governance_mcp tests.test_drift_review tests.test_development_monitor tests.test_replay_event_normalizer -v

items: Replacing the shared local AgentGov runtime can affect other open Codex sessions that use the same executable.
An App Server bridge could accidentally answer a human-owned form or retain sensitive event content.
A replay against a non-due or stale repository could produce misleading negative evidence.
A successful immutable record followed by a Monitor refresh failure could be retried incorrectly.
Installed-runtime evidence could be overstated as a stable release or consumer-adoption result.

stop_conditions: Stop if the exact source fails focused validation, cannot be built offline, or installed hashes and identities do not match the reviewed source.
Stop before terminating any process not proven to be an AgentGov governance-MCP child chain or before replacing any environment other than the existing AgentGov pipx runtime.
Stop the replay without a write if the native human decision cannot be surfaced, the repository is not due, the state digest changes, or the bridge would have to choose for the human.
Stop before source fixes, project configuration edits, another replay, consumer mutation, Git write, publication, release, deployment, or production execution.

decision.rationale: The product owner explicitly selected plan item 1 after reviewing that it required a separate local Adapter 1.4.0 installation and exactly one independent Native MCP drift-review form replay. The exact offline wheel is installed and hash-matched; installed discovery and regression pass. The one measured direct App Server call reached exactly one thread-bound native form request, supplied no human decision, and wrote no record. This proves installed forwarding but not live Agent selection, end-user UI presentation, or human decision application. The task is paused after its one replay; another replay, source/configuration change, consumer activation, Git write, publication, release, or deployment is unauthorized.
